component.name: aws-bedrock-agent-runtime
component.title: AWS Bedrock Agent Runtime
component.description: Query Amazon Bedrock knowledge bases, and invoke Amazon Bedrock agents, inline agents and flows.
component.label: ai,cloud

configuration.description: The configuration that the endpoints of the component start from. Each endpoint uses a copy of it, in which its own URI options replace the values.

knowledgeBaseId.description: The ID of the knowledge base that retrieve and retrieveAndGenerate query. The other operations do not use it, and neither do these with pojoRequest.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

modelId.description: The ID or ARN of the model that retrieveAndGenerate generates the answer with, for example anthropic.claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022-v2:0. The other operations do not use it, and neither does retrieveAndGenerate with pojoRequest.

operation.description: The operation that the producer performs. The CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeOperation header replaces this option.

overrideEndpoint.description: Whether to send the requests to the URI of the uriEndpointOverride option instead of the endpoint of the region. It has no effect when uriEndpointOverride is not set.

pojoRequest.description: Whether the body is the request object of the AWS SDK for the operation, which the producer sends as it is: a RetrieveAndGenerateRequest, RetrieveRequest, InvokeFlowRequest, InvokeAgentRequest or InvokeInlineAgentRequest. The options and headers that build the request are then not used, and a body of another type fails the exchange.

profileCredentialsName.description: The name of the profile in the AWS shared credentials and config files, used when useProfileCredentialsProvider is true. If not set, the AWS SDK uses its default profile, which the AWS_PROFILE environment variable can change.

region.description: The AWS region of Amazon Bedrock, as a region ID such as us-east-1, which is the value of Region.US_EAST_1.id(). If not set, the AWS SDK takes the region from its default region provider chain, for example the AWS_REGION environment variable.

uriEndpointOverride.description: The URI of the endpoint to use instead of the endpoint of the region, for example http://localhost:4566 for a local emulator. It is used only when overrideEndpoint is true.

useDefaultCredentialsProvider.description: Whether to load the credentials with the default credentials provider chain of the AWS SDK, which looks in system properties, environment variables, the shared credentials and config files, and the container or instance role. It takes precedence over the other credentials options.

useProfileCredentialsProvider.description: Whether to load the credentials from a profile of the AWS shared credentials and config files, the one of the profileCredentialsName option. It is not used when useDefaultCredentialsProvider is true, and it takes precedence over the session and static credentials.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

bedrockAgentRuntimeAsyncClient.label: advanced
bedrockAgentRuntimeAsyncClient.description: To use a custom software.amazon.awssdk.services.bedrockagentruntime.BedrockAgentRuntimeAsyncClient for invokeFlow, invokeAgent and invokeInlineAgent, which receive their response as an event stream. When it is not set, the endpoint builds one from the credentials, region, proxy and endpoint override options: at start when the operation option is one of these, or else on first use. The Camel endpoint does not close a client that is set or autowired.

bedrockAgentRuntimeClient.label: advanced
bedrockAgentRuntimeClient.description: To use a custom software.amazon.awssdk.services.bedrockagentruntime.BedrockAgentRuntimeClient for retrieve and retrieveAndGenerate. When this option is set or autowired, the credentials, region, proxy, endpoint override and trustAllCertificates options are not used for this client. The Camel endpoint does not close a client that is set or autowired.

agentAliasId.label: agent
agentAliasId.description: The ID of the alias of the agent that invokeAgent invokes. The CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeAgentAliasId header replaces this option.

agentId.label: agent
agentId.description: The ID of the agent that invokeAgent invokes. The CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeAgentId header replaces this option.

enableTrace.label: flow,agent
enableTrace.description: Whether invokeFlow, invokeAgent and invokeInlineAgent ask for the trace events of the invocation, which the producer gives in the CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeFlowTraces or CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeAgentTraces header. The CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeFlowEnableTrace header replaces it for invokeFlow, and the CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeAgentEnableTrace header for the agent operations.

foundationModel.label: agent
foundationModel.description: The ID of the foundation model that the inline agent of invokeInlineAgent uses, for example anthropic.claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022-v2:0. The CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeAgentFoundationModel header replaces this option.

instruction.label: agent
instruction.description: The instructions that tell the inline agent of invokeInlineAgent what to do and how to interact with users. The CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeAgentInstruction header replaces this option.

sessionId.label: agent
sessionId.description: The ID of the session of invokeAgent and invokeInlineAgent: reuse the same value to continue the conversation. The CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeSessionId header replaces this option. If neither is set, the producer uses a random ID for each message, and gives it in that header.

streamOutputMode.label: agent
streamOutputMode.description: How invokeAgent and invokeInlineAgent give the answer: complete gives the whole text as a String, and chunks gives a List of the text of each chunk. In both modes the producer waits until the agent has finished. The CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeAgentStreamOutputMode header replaces this option.

flowAliasIdentifier.label: flow
flowAliasIdentifier.description: The ID of the alias of the flow that invokeFlow invokes. The CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeFlowAliasIdentifier header replaces this option.

flowIdentifier.label: flow
flowIdentifier.description: The ID of the flow that invokeFlow invokes. The CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeFlowIdentifier header replaces this option.

healthCheckConsumerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckConsumerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all consumer based health checks from this component

healthCheckProducerEnabled.label: health
healthCheckProducerEnabled.description: Used for enabling or disabling all producer based health checks from this component. Notice: Camel has by default disabled all producer based health-checks. You can turn on producer checks globally by setting camel.health.producersEnabled=true.

proxyHost.label: proxy
proxyHost.description: The host name of the proxy that the HTTP clients of Bedrock Agent Runtime connect through. The proxy is used only when the proxyPort option is set too.

proxyPort.label: proxy
proxyPort.description: The port of the proxy that the HTTP clients of Bedrock Agent Runtime connect through. The proxy is used only when the proxyHost option is set too.

proxyProtocol.label: proxy
proxyProtocol.description: The protocol that the HTTP clients of Bedrock Agent Runtime use to connect to the proxy. It is used only when the proxyHost and proxyPort options are set.

accessKey.label: security
accessKey.description: The access key ID of the AWS credentials, used together with the secretKey option. It is required, unless bedrockAgentRuntimeClient is set or useDefaultCredentialsProvider, useProfileCredentialsProvider or useSessionCredentials is true.

secretKey.label: security
secretKey.description: The secret access key of the AWS credentials, used together with the accessKey option. It is required, unless bedrockAgentRuntimeClient is set or useDefaultCredentialsProvider, useProfileCredentialsProvider or useSessionCredentials is true.

sessionToken.label: security
sessionToken.description: The session token of temporary AWS credentials, for example of an assumed IAM role. It is used only when useSessionCredentials is true, together with the accessKey and secretKey options. When it is not set, the accessKey and secretKey options are used without a session token.

trustAllCertificates.label: security
trustAllCertificates.description: Whether the HTTP clients of Bedrock Agent Runtime trust every TLS certificate without checking it. It applies to any endpoint, not only to an overridden one, so use it only for testing, for example against a local emulator.

useSessionCredentials.label: security
useSessionCredentials.description: Whether to use temporary credentials made of the accessKey, secretKey and sessionToken options, for example those of an assumed IAM role. It is not used when useDefaultCredentialsProvider or useProfileCredentialsProvider is true.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeOperation.description: The operation that the producer performs. It replaces the operation option.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeCitations.description: The citations of the answer, which link its parts to the sources that they come from. Set by retrieveAndGenerate, invokeAgent and invokeInlineAgent when the answer has citations.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeSessionId.description: The ID of the session. retrieveAndGenerate, invokeAgent and invokeInlineAgent read it to continue a session, and set it to the session of the response; for the agent operations it replaces the sessionId option.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeAgentId.description: The ID of the agent for invokeAgent. It replaces the agentId option.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeAgentAliasId.description: The ID of the alias of the agent for invokeAgent. It replaces the agentAliasId option.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeAgentEnableTr.description: Whether invokeAgent and invokeInlineAgent ask for the trace events of the invocation. It replaces the enableTrace option for them.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeAgentEndSessi.description: Whether invokeAgent and invokeInlineAgent end the session after this invocation.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeAgentMemoryId.description: The ID of the memory of the agent for invokeAgent, which keeps a summary of the earlier sessions. invokeInlineAgent does not read it.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeAgentStreamOu.description: The output mode of invokeAgent and invokeInlineAgent: complete or chunks. It replaces the streamOutputMode option.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeAgentFoundati.description: The ID of the foundation model of the inline agent for invokeInlineAgent. It replaces the foundationModel option.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeAgentInstruct.description: The instructions of the inline agent for invokeInlineAgent. It replaces the instruction option.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeAgentTraces.description: The trace events of the invocation: TracePart elements for invokeAgent, and InlineAgentTracePart elements for invokeInlineAgent. Set when the trace is enabled and the agent sends trace events.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeAgentReturnCo.description: The actions that the agent returns to the caller to carry out, instead of calling an action group itself: ReturnControlPayload elements for invokeAgent, and InlineAgentReturnControlPayload elements for invokeInlineAgent. Set when the agent returns control.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeAgentFiles.description: The files that the agent generated: FilePart elements for invokeAgent, and InlineAgentFilePart elements for invokeInlineAgent. Set when the agent sends files.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeFlowIdentifie.description: The ID of the flow for invokeFlow. It replaces the flowIdentifier option.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeFlowAliasIden.description: The ID of the alias of the flow for invokeFlow. It replaces the flowAliasIdentifier option.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeFlowEnableTra.description: Whether invokeFlow asks for the trace events of the flow. It replaces the enableTrace option for invokeFlow.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeFlowExecution.description: The ID of a flow execution that invokeFlow continues, for a flow that waits for more input, as in a multi-turn conversation.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeFlowOutputs.description: The output events of the flow, set by invokeFlow, as an empty List when the flow has no output. The body is the document of the last one.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeFlowTraces.description: The trace events of the flow. Set by invokeFlow when the trace is enabled and the flow sends trace events.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeFlowCompletio.description: The reason why the flow completed: SUCCESS, or INPUT_REQUIRED when it waits for more input. Set by invokeFlow when the flow sends a completion event.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeRetrievedResu.description: The results that retrieve found in the knowledge base, the same List as the body.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeNumberOfResul.description: The maximum number of results that retrieve returns. If not set, Amazon Bedrock uses its default.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeSearchType.description: The search type of retrieve: HYBRID, which combines the vector search with a text search, or SEMANTIC, which uses the vector search only. If not set, Amazon Bedrock chooses one.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeNextToken.description: The token of the next page of the results of retrieve. Set it to get that page; retrieve sets it when there are more results, and removes it when there are none.

CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeRetrieveGuard.description: Whether the guardrail of the knowledge base intervened in retrieve: INTERVENED or NONE. Set by retrieve when the response has it, and removed otherwise.

producerIn.description: The question, the query or the input of the agent as text for retrieveAndGenerate, retrieve, invokeAgent and invokeInlineAgent: bytes, a stream or a file are read as text, a Map or a Jackson JsonNode is sent as JSON text, another POJO as its toString(), so take the text out of it first, and no body fails. invokeFlow takes a String, which becomes the document of the input node FlowInputNode, or a FlowInput or a List of FlowInput of the AWS SDK: another body is read as text, as for the other operations. With pojoRequest=true the request of the AWS SDK for the operation, such as a RetrieveAndGenerateRequest: another body fails

producerOut.description: The answer as text for retrieveAndGenerate, with the citations and the session id in headers, and a List of KnowledgeBaseRetrievalResult for retrieve. invokeAgent and invokeInlineAgent give the answer as text, or a List of the chunks with streamOutputMode=chunks or the CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeAgentStreamOutputMode header; the text is empty when the agent returns control. invokeFlow gives the document of the last output of the flow as text, or as a Document of the AWS SDK for another type, and keeps the body when the flow has no output

label.description: A logical name of the endpoint, which you choose freely. The producer does not use it: the knowledge base, agent or flow and the operation are given by options and headers.

knowledgeBaseId.description: The ID of the knowledge base that retrieve and retrieveAndGenerate query. The other operations do not use it, and neither do these with pojoRequest.

modelId.description: The ID or ARN of the model that retrieveAndGenerate generates the answer with, for example anthropic.claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022-v2:0. The other operations do not use it, and neither does retrieveAndGenerate with pojoRequest.

The options and headers that build the request are then not used, and a body of another type fails the exchange.

profileCredentialsName.description: The name of the profile in the AWS shared credentials and config files, used when useProfileCredentialsProvider is true. If not set, the AWS SDK uses its default profile, which the AWS_PROFILE environment variable can change.

region.description: The AWS region of Amazon Bedrock, as a region ID such as us-east-1, which is the value of Region.US_EAST_1.id(). If not set, the AWS SDK takes the region from its default region provider chain, for example the AWS_REGION environment variable.

uriEndpointOverride.description: The URI of the endpoint to use instead of the endpoint of the region, for example http://localhost:4566 for a local emulator. It is used only when overrideEndpoint is true.

useDefaultCredentialsProvider.description: Whether to load the credentials with the default credentials provider chain of the AWS SDK, which looks in system properties, environment variables, the shared credentials and config files, and the container or instance role. It takes precedence over the other credentials options.

useProfileCredentialsProvider.description: Whether to load the credentials from a profile of the AWS shared credentials and config files, the one of the profileCredentialsName option. It is not used when useDefaultCredentialsProvider is true, and it takes precedence over the session and static credentials.

agentId.label: agent

foundationModel.description: The ID of the foundation model that the inline agent of invokeInlineAgent uses, for example anthropic.claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022-v2:0. The CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeAgentFoundationModel header replaces this option.

flowAliasIdentifier.label: flow
flowAliasIdentifier.description: The ID of the alias of the flow that invokeFlow invokes. The CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeFlowAliasIdentifier header replaces this option.

flowIdentifier.label: flow
flowIdentifier.description: The ID of the flow that invokeFlow invokes. The CamelAwsBedrockAgentRuntimeFlowIdentifier header replaces this option.

proxyHost.label: proxy
proxyHost.description: The host name of the proxy that the HTTP clients of Bedrock Agent Runtime connect through. The proxy is used only when the proxyPort option is set too.

proxyPort.label: proxy
proxyPort.description: The port of the proxy that the HTTP clients of Bedrock Agent Runtime connect through. The proxy is used only when the proxyHost option is set too.

proxyProtocol.label: proxy
proxyProtocol.description: The protocol that the HTTP clients of Bedrock Agent Runtime use to connect to the proxy. It is used only when the proxyHost and proxyPort options are set.

accessKey.label: security
accessKey.description: The access key ID of the AWS credentials, used together with the secretKey option. It is required, unless bedrockAgentRuntimeClient is set or useDefaultCredentialsProvider, useProfileCredentialsProvider or useSessionCredentials is true.

secretKey.label: security
secretKey.description: The secret access key of the AWS credentials, used together with the accessKey option. It is required, unless bedrockAgentRuntimeClient is set or useDefaultCredentialsProvider, useProfileCredentialsProvider or useSessionCredentials is true.

sessionToken.label: security
sessionToken.description: The session token of temporary AWS credentials, for example of an assumed IAM role. It is used only when useSessionCredentials is true, together with the accessKey and secretKey options. When it is not set, the accessKey and secretKey options are used without a session token.

trustAllCertificates.label: security
trustAllCertificates.description: Whether the HTTP clients of Bedrock Agent Runtime trust every TLS certificate without checking it. It applies to any endpoint, not only to an overridden one, so use it only for testing, for example against a local emulator.

useSessionCredentials.label: security
useSessionCredentials.description: Whether to use temporary credentials made of the accessKey, secretKey and sessionToken options, for example those of an assumed IAM role. It is not used when useDefaultCredentialsProvider or useProfileCredentialsProvider is true.
